faults.quote: The domestic bird raised for its meat and eggs.
faults.why: 'thịt gà' means only chicken meat; the live bird is 'gà' or 'con gà'.

faults.quote: It refers to both the live animal as food source
faults.why: False: 'thịt gà' never refers to the live animal.

faults.quote: Người nông dân nuôi nhiều thịt gà trong trang trại.
faults.why: Absurd in Vietnamese ('raises much chicken meat'); one raises 'gà', not 'thịt gà'.

faults.quote: Chúng tôi ăn thịt gà cho bữa tối.
faults.why: 'cho bữa tối' is a calque of 'for dinner'; natural Vietnamese is 'vào bữa tối'.
